design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (delivery_and_installation_appointments). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,5]; the kit settlement and the replacement haul-away take 5 factors each. Revision 2 (rework after audits/policy_task/.../1.md and _difficulty.md) is recorded at the end under REVISION LOG.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Bartholomew asks only for the old washer and dryer to be hauled away at Thursday's installation. The haul-away rule counts the old appliances removed from the kit units the appointment's installation parts kit entries carry and says the charge is fixed only once those entries cover every appliance installed. The records show two appliances on the delivered purchase and one kit unit, so the agent must find in the kit rule that the missing kit is owed, price it (contractor price for a Business tier with fewer than 4 appliance units in twelve whole months, fittings-stock and tenure reductions, the kit place schedule for two appliances, Visa discount), post it, and only then price the removal (no included items for a business account, purchase-size fee, recycler trip schedule, late-request surcharge, renewal-billing discount) and hand the authorization to the member. Difficulty sits in reading which records count (delivered purchase vs other purchases; twelve-whole-month window excluding the 2025 dishwashers) and in arithmetic, not in picking tools.
SCOPE: task 0 occupied the distance settlement, reschedule settlement and wall-mount addition with their three tools. Task 1 claims the two remaining policies, delivery_ext_install_kit_settlement and delivery_ext_replacement_haul_away, with post_installation_kit_charge_19cc3b17 (agent) and authorize_haul_away_734a64e4 (user). With M=2 nothing is left unclaimed: the five extended policies are covered by the two tasks with disjoint scopes.
POLICIES / TRIGGERS / LINEAGE: both refine delivery_service_charged (refs delivery_booking_and_fees, delivery_reschedule, delivery_failed_attempts; haul-away also delivery_crew_scope for the crew's removal scope). Kit settlement is state_due (the kit for an appliance being installed is owed whether or not anyone calls); haul-away is on_request. Overwrites: kit replaces 'one installation_parts_kit per appliance installed at installation_parts_kit_fee_usd'; haul-away replaces 'haul-away of old items beyond haul_away_included_items at haul_away_fee_per_item_usd each, only where haul_away_available'. Inherited: zero components not entered, haul-away only where available (Appliance Delivery & Installation: available, 1 included, $25), fees never earn Annual Reward. Both also declare the base 'At booking the following are charged, each as its own entry dated the booking date ...' clause superseded by their own posting sentence (dated the posting date).
FACTOR CARD (kit, result 18.56, baseline 39.99): contractor_kit_price (parameter, membership; multi-source over membership_holdings.variant_name and order_lines volume): Business Plus AND 3 twelve-month appliance units -> $33.99 (Business & 4+ $27.99; other $39.99); baseline 22.61; near-miss: dishwashers of 2025-09-20 (MONTHS to 2026-10-05 = 12, not < 12) — counting them gives 5 units and $27.99 (kit 14.51). fittings_stock_reduction (parameter): 1 kit unit standing -> $2.50 (2+ $5.00; none 0); baseline 20.24. kit_tenure_reduction (parameter, membership): 204 whole months -> $4.00 (96-179 $2.00; <96 none); baseline 21.26. kit_place_schedule (method, order): exactly two appliances on the delivered purchase -> kits priced by their place in the appointment, first full and second three quarters; the kit owed is the second -> 0.75 (3+: first full, every later half; one: full); baseline every kit owed at full price -> 24.74; near-miss: the member's other appliance purchases are not installed here. kit_tender_discount (parameter, order): Northgate Visa -> 10% (store card 5%; other 0); baseline 20.62.
FACTOR CARD (haul-away, result 36.00, baseline 25.00): removal_included_items (parameter, membership): Business Plus -> no included items (Club Plus 2; other the service level's 1); baseline 24.00. removal_fee_by_purchase (parameter, order): delivered purchase 1,799.98 -> $20.00 per item (2,500+ $15.00; <1,500 $25.00); baseline 45.00; near-miss: the March refrigerator (another purchase) would push it to 3,099.97. recycler_trip_schedule (method): 14 days booking-to-delivery -> graduated, first appliance at the fee and every further one at half -> $30.00 (21+ days one consolidated trip, the fee once; <10 days itemized); baseline itemized 48.00. late_removal_surcharge (parameter): 3 days to delivery -> 50 percent added (<=1 day 100 percent; >=6 nothing); baseline 24.00. renewal_billing_discount (parameter, membership; auto_renew and its tender sit on one membership row, so it is not counted as multi-source): auto-renew on AND billed to the Northgate Visa -> 20% (other tender 10%; not on automatic renewal 0); baseline 45.00. No figure of either computation is an exact half cent (raw products 18.55575, 22.60575, 20.24325, 21.25575, 24.741, 20.6175, 39.99, 36, 24, 45, 48, 25), so the rules' half-up rounding and the gate's RND agree.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: delivery_booking_and_fees (gates apply to delivery_scheduled -> policy_scope), delivery_reschedule (its sentence 'A reschedule is free only when ... otherwise reschedule_fee_usd is charged ...' is superseded in full by the reschedule settlement, which retires the free_reschedule_notice gate -> policy_scope; appointment never moved), delivery_failed_attempts (gates on rebooking -> policy_scope; no attempt). No time gate on these writes; temporal_feasibility []. Base facts checked: status scheduled; Appliance Delivery & Installation installs washer and electric_dryer and disconnects the old ones (old_appliance_disconnect_included true); nothing gas (caller statement); presence required, the member will be there.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target appointment 8bcdcfd5-4a87-490b-a5a6-04503c8296f3 (order b912d824-8f42-402d-aba8-38db7a7e025c). Included rows: the kit entry 130426b2-05c2-44dd-86ee-662b5d567ce0 (1 unit), the delivered purchase lines e59877f6-7157-4733-9849-6cea8f331e52 and 0c103f28-e086-4eb2-bf6f-1bbcb5ca61ab, the twelve-month appliance lines (those two + 35547b83-15bd-48cc-9137-68cd77a534cd). Excluded by the rules: dde1cb3b-74ee-4333-89cf-96cf6328a96d (12 whole months old) from the contractor volume, 35547b83-15bd-48cc-9137-68cd77a534cd from per-purchase counts and amounts. Both tools write this appointment's delivery_id and customer_id.
SEED ROWS: customers, membership_holdings (Business Plus, opened 2009-09-28, auto-renew on Northgate Visa, current year from 2026-09-28 so Annual Reward balance 0.00), three order_holdings (delivered purchase placed; March and 2025 purchases fulfilled at the register), four order_lines, one delivery_holdings, one delivery_charges (the booking kit in the first place, priced by the kit rule as of 2026-09-24: (33.99 - 0 - 4.00) x 1 x 0.90 = 26.99). Removing the kit row makes 2 kits owed and changes the stock reduction; removing the dryer line removes the owed kit and the prerequisite; removing the refrigerator changes the volume (2) but not the tier; removing the dishwashers removes the near-miss. No other state-due obligation is lit: distance 37 within the 50-mile radius, never moved, no attempt, no claim, no television.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root delivery_ext_replacement_haul_away (owner=user, authorize_haul_away_734a64e4). Edge root -> delivery_ext_install_kit_settlement, value_input, gate old_appliances, form state, sentence 'The haul-away charge for the old appliances an installation replaces is fixed only once the appointment's installation parts kit entries cover every appliance it installs.' (affirmative; the charter's other sentences include the negated 'is not fixed until'). False at the opening: kit units 1 vs 2 appliances (delivery_charges.130426b2-05c2-44dd-86ee-662b5d567ce0.units = 1; order_lines washer 1 + dryer 1). Resolved by post_installation_kit_charge_19cc3b17 (agent), the only write in this difficulty that books installation parts kit entries. Four-point test: 'only once' ordering connective; waits on a record-visible state (kit entries covering every appliance installed); no tool/id/code token; hard requirement, scope exactly the condition. Derivation: sentence + records (1 of 2) + kit rule ('Kits the appointment's installation parts kit entries do not yet cover are owed, and they are posted together as one installation parts kit entry') -> post the kit. Deletion sensitivity: skip kit -> haul-away 24.00 instead of 36.00. user_scenario mentions no kit and no charge to settle; the tools never check anything.
PERSONA DESIGN: a brisk landlord calling from his truck; volunteers the surface request (haul away the old washer and dryer at Thursday's installation) and phone 6145550362; on request: ZIP 43082, DOB 1969-11-23, email, the purchase (washer and dryer only, Gahanna club, September 24, business membership, Northgate Visa), the old machines (top-load washer, electric dryer, first-floor laundry, nothing gas), presence Thursday morning. Passive branches: a missed charge explained -> lets it be posted, no waiver ask; authorization handed over -> runs it with the details given; closes when told the removal is booked; refusal branch -> ends without another ask. He knows no amounts.
REACHABILITY / EASY MISTAKES / STANDARD SOLUTION: all inputs are initial_state rows, the step-8 kit row and the caller's request; both writes complete synchronously at frozen_time 2026-10-05 15:10:00 EDT. Mistakes: pricing the removal before posting the kit (1 old appliance: 24.00); giving the business account the included item (24.00); counting the 2025 dishwashers (contractor $27.99 -> kit 14.51); counting the refrigerator in the delivered purchase ($15.00 an item); pricing the owed kit in the first place (full price) although one kit already stands; itemizing the removal although 14 days allow the graduated schedule. Solution: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> find_delivery_holdings -> find_delivery_charges -> find_order_holdings -> find_order_lines -> find_membership_holdings -> unlock+call post_installation_kit_charge_19cc3b17(kits 1, amount 18.56, service_date 2026-10-08) -> unlock_user authorize_haul_away_734a64e4, member calls it (old_items 2, amount 36.00, service_date 2026-10-08).
VERIFICATION: authoring replay (real tools, topological order, raw products checked for half-cent ties) printed kit 18.56 (baseline 39.99; contractor 22.61, stock 20.24, tenure 21.26, place schedule 24.74, tender 20.62), haul-away 36.0 (baseline 25.0; included 24.0, fee 45.0, recycler schedule 48.0, late 24.0, renewal 45.0), SKIP kit -> haul-away 24.0. The persistent runnable entry point is `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0039_warehouse_club_retailer/tasks/delivery_and_installation_appointments --task 1`, which recomputes the same expected, factor_sensitivity and baseline_result. Per-task gates (--task 1) re-run green after revision 2; traceability deferred until the KB is rendered.
CLOSURE AND DRAFT RECOMPUTATION: kit -> post_installation_kit_charge_19cc3b17 -> step 8 amount 18.56 -> installation_parts_kit row; haul-away -> authorize_haul_away_734a64e4 -> step 10 amount 36.00 -> haul_away row; charter_scope = required_documents = computations' policies = the tree. From the published rules, the find_* returns and the persona alone (compute/GT masked) a reader reaches the same order (kit then removal), objects and figures; the rules pin the units (kits owed; one old appliance per kit unit), the twelve-whole-month window, the delivered-purchase scope of amounts, reductions before the place schedule, the single discount at the end and half-up rounding once.
MANUAL VALUE GATES (task 1): the owner=user write is the member's own consent to a paid removal and completes on the spot; object/timing/authorization explicit; no extra ask; volunteered facts all in initial_state; no time gate; authority facts are system rows; the prerequisite sentence is state form with a single writer; rule/compute swept both ways via compute_basis; every factor's baseline is the baseline paragraph's default (service level kit fee, per-item fee and included items; no reduction, multiplier or discount) and each moves the result on this world. Method labels are honest: the kit place schedule prices kits by their place (first full, later at a share), and the recycler trip schedule chooses between one consolidated charge, a graduated charge and an itemized charge; every other factor is labelled parameter because its tiers select a value (a price, a reduction, an included count, a percentage).
REVISION LOG (round 2): T1-1/F-4 -> installed_appliance_scaling (a scalar) replaced by kit_place_schedule (kits priced by their place), late_removal_multiplier relabelled as a parameter surcharge (late_removal_surcharge), and the planning reduction replaced by recycler_trip_schedule (consolidated / graduated / itemized). The booking kit seed amount follows the place schedule (20.24 -> 26.99). Haul-away gold 40.80 -> 36.00; kit gold unchanged at 18.56; objects, order, owners and units unchanged. O-2 -> 'At booking ...' clause declared superseded on both policies. O-T1-a -> renewal_billing_discount no longer described as multi-source. O-T1-d -> the base reschedule sentence is now superseded in full, so the retirement statement holds. O-1 -> no stated figure is an exact half cent.
user_scenario: You are Bartholomew Szczepanski-Oyelaran, who owns a handful of rental houses around Columbus through Oyelaran Rental Homes LLC. It is Monday afternoon and you are calling Northgate member services from your truck between two showings. You are brisk and friendly, used to dealing with contractors, and you like to get to the point. You bought a new washer and an electric dryer for one of the rentals and Northgate is installing them this Thursday morning. You want the crew to take the old washer and dryer away when they install the new ones, so the tenant is not left with them in the laundry room. That is what you are calling for: add the removal of the old pair to Thursday's installation. You are not changing the date or anything else. You open with something like: "Hi, I've got a washer and dryer being installed Thursday at one of my rentals, and I want your crew to haul away the old washer and dryer while they're there." You give the phone number on the account, 6145550362, to be looked up. If you are asked for more to confirm who you are, you give your home ZIP code, 43082, and if they need one more thing your date of birth, 1969-11-23; you give your email, bart.szczepanski@oyelaranrentalhomes.com, only if someone asks for it specifically. You do not have any reference numbers handy. If asked about the purchase, you say it was the washer and the dryer only, bought at the Gahanna club on September 24 on the business membership and paid with your Northgate Visa. If asked about the old machines, you say they are an old top-load washer and an old electric dryer in the first-floor laundry room, nothing gas, and that you will be at the house yourself Thursday morning to let the crew in. You do not remember what the installation cost you so far and you never guess at amounts. If the representative tells you that something on the appointment has to be put right before the removal can be added, or that a charge was missed when the installation was booked, you ask what it is for, and once it is explained you tell them to go ahead and put it on if it belongs there; you do not ask for anything to be waived. When the representative tells you what the removal will cost and hands the haul-away authorization over to you, you go through it yourself with exactly the details they give you and read back what it shows; if they ask whether you agree to the charge first, you say yes. You wrap up the call, thanking them, as soon as you hear the removal is booked for Thursday. If they tell you the removal cannot be added, you thank them, say you will have your handyman deal with the old machines, and end the call without asking for anything else.

base_preconditions.condition: The booking-and-fees policy prices every fee component of an appointment; its eligibility gates apply to booking an appointment, not to posting a fee entry on an existing one.

The reschedule policy governs fee entries for moves; its sentence 'A reschedule is free only when ... otherwise reschedule_fee_usd is charged ...' is superseded in full by the reschedule settlement policy, so no gate of it remains on a fee posting; the appointment has never been moved.
The failed-attempts policy's gates apply to rebooking only; the appointment has had no attempt.
